subject: Hosted API sandbox access & rate limits — next steps
messages:
From: Samir Rao <samir@finlytics.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Chang <lisa.chang@finlytics.com>
Date: 2028-04-28T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Quick follow-up after demo — hosted evaluation questions

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — the team liked the latency profile and the KV caching examples. We wanted to capture a few quick follow-ups so we can decide whether Hosted API meets our needs or whether we need to evaluate Dedicated/Private: 

- Sandbox access: can you provide a sandbox endpoint and short onboarding steps so our engineers can validate prefix caching and basic integration?
- Rate limits / quotas: what are the default per-account and per-endpoint limits (qps, per-minute bursts, concurrency)? If we need to hit sustained ~20 req/s with minute-long bursts to 200, what does that look like?
- Endpoints & routing: can we get a named staging endpoint for our account (so we can pin traffic during the eval)?
- Data retention & logs: what retention window do you maintain for request logs & KV cache keys for Hosted customers? Our security/infra team will want to confirm.

If you can send a short checklist and sandbox creds, we’ll get eng to try an integration this week. Also looping in Lisa from Security for any SOC2/compliance artifacts.

Best,
Samir
CTO, FinLytics
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir@finlytics.com>
Cc: Lisa Chang <lisa.chang@finlytics.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-28T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up after demo — hosted evaluation questions

Samir — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front and an action plan below. I attached a one-page sandbox onboarding doc with step-by-step creds and endpoint names.

High-level answers:
- Sandbox access: yes — we can provision a named staging endpoint for you (finlytics-staging) with dedicated keys. See attached PDF for the auth flow.
- Rate limits / quotas: default Hosted quotas are conservative. For your expected profile (sustained ~20 req/s, bursts to 200/min) we recommend either a reserved burst package on Hosted or a small Dedicated pool. Hosted can support it for the eval; Aditya will confirm exact quota numbers and how to apply for a temporary burst increase for the trial.
- Endpoints & routing: we’ll create a staging endpoint scoped to your account. That endpoint supports canary routing rules if you want to split test variants.
- Data retention & logs: Hosted retains request logs and traces for 30 days by default; we can provide SOC2 evidence for your procurement team and extend log retention as a paid add-on.

Action items (proposed):
1) I’ll provision sandbox creds and staging endpoint today and share them in a secure note. (attachment: redwood-sandbox-instructions.pdf)
2) Aditya — please confirm the temporary quota we can set for finlytics-staging and steps for them to request a longer-term reserved capacity evaluation.
3) Samir/Lisa — can you confirm the traffic profile below so we provision correctly: region = us-west, sustained 20 req/s, typical sequence length ~120 tokens, peak minute bursts up to 200 requests.
4) If Security needs anything else (S3 key rotation, log exports), Lauren will coordinate with your team.

Would you like a 30-minute follow-up on Friday to validate the sandbox once the creds are in?

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
redwood.com
From: Samir Rao <samir@finlytics.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Chang <lisa.chang@finlytics.com>
Date: 2028-04-28T12:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up after demo — hosted evaluation questions

Thanks Vivek — that plan works. Confirming traffic & timing:
- Region: us-west (primary), fallback us-east
- Sustained: 20 req/s
- Bursts: up to ~200 reqs/min for 2–3 minute spikes
- Avg sequence length: 120 tokens; peak sessions may reach 400 tokens for long-form summary jobs

On procurement/security: Lisa will need SOC2 Type II evidence + a short doc on data retention and whether customer data is ever persisted in logs beyond the 30-day window. She asked me to CC her (done).

We’d like sandbox creds today if possible — our engineers are standing by. Friday 30-min works for a sandbox validation call.

—Samir
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
